chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Suleyman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Jews, the Christians, and the Magians are not sworn (in oaths) by other than Allah.
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'Therefore judge between them by what Allah has Revealed.'
ai.seo_question: How should oaths be administered to Jews, Christians, and Magians according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the jurisprudential principle that oaths administered to Jews, Christians, and Zoroastrians must be sworn by Allah alone, rejecting their specific religious invocations. By citing the verse 'judge between them by what Allah has revealed,' it underscores the supremacy of divine authority in legal proceedings, a view supported by Shia jurists who emphasize that while their internal theology may differ, their legal testimony in Islamic courts is validated by the Creator of all. This ruling ensures that the oath retains its binding nature under Islamic law while respecting the monotheistic foundation of the People of the Book.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not get to swear, neither the Jews, nor the Christians, nor the Magians without Allah<sup>azwj</sup>.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [5:48] therefore judge between them by what Allah has Revealed’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Jews, Christians and Zoroastrian are not made to take an oath by anything other than Allah,
most Majestic, most Glorious, who says, ‘Judge among them by means of what Allah has revealed.’ [5:52]”
